initial_scene: Seated humanoid facing the monitor and tabletop. A crumpled yellow cloth lies on the tabletop beside the monitor stand. The far-side articulated right hand is empty below the tabletop; the nearer white left hand is by the lap.

observed_sequence.action: Robot holds the seated starting pose with empty hands; yellow cloth rests beside monitor stand.
The nearer left hand lowers slightly toward the lap while the far-side right arm extends toward the tabletop and opens its articulated fingers above the yellow cloth.
Right hand lowers onto the cloth, adjusts the fingers and closes around a portion of the fabric while it remains on the tabletop. The left hand stays low without assisting.
Right hand lifts the gathered yellow cloth off the tabletop and carries it upward toward the lower-middle screen surface. Fabric remains held in the right fingers.

Held cloth is pressed against the screen and moved in short back-and-forth strokes, principally sideways with small vertical variation. Yellow reflection moves with the cloth; right elbow and wrist change while the robot stays seated.
Right arm moves the cloth away from the screen and down to the tabletop beside the monitor, settling the fabric back onto the surface.
Right fingers open, leaving the cloth on the tabletop. The empty right hand lifts away and retracts below table level; left hand remains near the lap.

arm_hand_roles.right: Sole manipulating hand: reaches, grasps yellow cloth, lifts, holds it against the screen for wiping, returns and releases it on the tabletop, then withdraws empty.
arm_hand_roles.left: Nearer arm with white hand remains by the lap after a small initial lowering; no cloth grasp, screen support or transfer.
arm_hand_roles.coordination: One-handed tool use; no hand-to-hand transfer and no coordinated supporting contact.

anatomical_side_evidence.evidence: The robot faces image-left toward the monitor. Its front torso plane and face point toward that monitor, and the camera views the robot from its left-front side. The nearer shoulder and arm running down the visible outside of the torso lead to the white hand by the lap, establishing anatomical left. The active articulated hand traces through the opposite, farther elbow/upper arm to the right shoulder across the far side of the chest, establishing anatomical right. This naming follows body attachment rather than horizontal image position.
anatomical_side_evidence.uncertainty: No material anatomical-side ambiguity in the inspected initial and extended-arm frames.

visual_inspection_coverage.method: Viewed all five full-video contact sheets and all requested native PNGs, plus the native source initial PNG.

terminal_state: Yellow cloth rests released on the tabletop beside the monitor stand. Right hand is empty and retracted below the tabletop; robot remains seated and the left hand is near the lap. Monitor stays upright.
selected_execution_status_basis: Observed grasp, cloth-to-screen wiping motion, return to tabletop and visible release complete the filmed manipulation. This does not assert a measured cleaning result.
uncertainties: Applied pressure and removal of dirt cannot be measured from the video; the review establishes visible cloth contact and wiping only.
world_model_prompt: The humanoid robot grasps the yellow cloth on the tabletop with its right hand and lifts it to the monitor. It presses the cloth against the lower-middle part of the screen and wipes back and forth with short strokes. It lowers the cloth back onto the tabletop beside the monitor, releases it, and withdraws its empty hand. Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.
original_task_instruction: This task involves cleaning a monitor screen with a cloth, requiring gentle pressure and careful surface contact to avoid damage.

selected_segment.reason: Complete original single-task reference; no cropping or trimming requested.
